newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Three Ecuadoran ministers submit resignations.
newsitem.headline: Three Ecuadoran ministers submit resignations.

text.p: Three Ecuadoran ministers, including key Energy Minister Alfredo Adum, said on Tuesday they had submitted their resignations to President Abdala Bucaram, and one said the rest of the cabinet would follow suit later in the day.

Housing Minister Victor Sicouret, in his surprise announcement, was not clear on the reasons for the move, saying only it was meant to let Bucaram, who has not yet accepted or rejected the resignations, make any necessary changes.
Industry Minister Jorge Marun also resigned.
"We are freeing up the president's hands so he can inject fresh air into the cabinet," Sicouret told reporters.
Adum, who oversees the oil sector that makes Ecuador's largest export earnings, faces two criminal suits for alleged assault and unjustified dismissal of workers from the state oil firm Petroecuador.
He also faces impeachment in Congress for alleged irregularities as energy minister. It was not immediately clear whether these cases had any connection with his resignation.
